{{Quote|Eat at Koe's|Advertisement on Orondia|<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>}}
'''Koe's''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An [[Aurebesh]] sign with an abstract motif, reading "EAT AT KOE'S", was used for advertisement.<ref name="FAE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Signage at the fueling station includes: Eat at Koe's, Bounty Emporium: Always Open, Bounty Never Sleeps; Security Services; Speeder Sales; The Pilot's Lounge (Live Band Every Night); Craft Repair and Maintenance; Repair Rack Droid Services; Orondia Tours; and Meteor Cafe.|Friends and Enemies Trivia Gallery|<ref name="Trivia Gallery" />}}
Koe's was first mentioned on a sign appearing in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Friends and Enemies]].<ref name="FAE" />
